0022600207.text: The Dallas Mavericks (6-4, 4-2 at home, on a two-game winning streak) host the Indiana Pacers (3-7, 0-5 at home, on a one-game losing streak) in the Mavericks' 11th game of the season. Dallas is 10th in the West and 2 games back in the Southwest, while Indiana is 11th in the East and 3.5 games back in the Central; the Mavericks are without Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), with Morez Johnson Jr. day-to-day after a leg injury, and the Pacers are without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), with T.J. McConnell day-to-day after a hamstring strain. Dallas leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 and won the 2025-26 series 2-0, most recently beating Indiana 121-105 in Indianapolis on October 23, 2026.
